{{Quote|Riding a suubatar is like riding the wind.|Bulgan|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Suubatars''' were majestic riding beasts native to the rolling plains of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. They were six meters tall, with protruding lavender eyes speckled with silver. The suubatar's smooth, tapered skull hinted that it was a creature of impressive speed. Suubatars pumped their six muscular legs when in full gait, gripping the grasslands with their long splayed toes, and launching themselves across the prairies in a speedy, yet smooth, run. At the command "[[List of phrases and slang|Elup]]!" they arose to launch into their gallop, raising one set of legs at a time: the front, middle, and finally rear. Each of their six feet had six toes, and they were exceptional swimmers.<ref name="AS" />

The suubatar body was long and narrow, ending in a lean, leg-length tail. They were covered in a coat of short, soft, and dense bronze-colored fur striped with distinctive patterns of green, providing excellent camouflage on the Ansonian plains. They had a single nostril, no mane, and their ears lay flat along their head. Suubatars had a superb 25kz range of sound.<ref name="AS" />

Suubatars were omnivores, with their massive jaws hinged to allow the swallowing of large fruit and small prey whole. Four canine teeth protruded above and below the jaw, giving them a fearsome appearance—which was a deceptive illusion, for the domesticated suubatar was ever gentle and patient when treated in kind. Suubatar riders sat in leather [[viann]] supports that elevated the driver above the suubatar's spinal ridge.<ref name="AS" />

Suubatars had long been domesticated and were typically reserved for the Alwari [[Highborn]]. To ride a suubatar was to mark oneself as being important and with good taste among the [[Alwari]]. These handsome, magnificent beasts were thus highly valued and expensive to purchase.<ref name="AS" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team consisting of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], secured six purebred suubatars for themselves and their Alwari guides while on their [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to settle a planetary border dispute and to convince all [[Unity of Community|parties]] involved to resist all [[Shu Mai/Legends|efforts]] at [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] and to vote to remain within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Jedi, who had bartered for the beasts, that they might carry them overland across the prairies in their search for the [[Borokii|ruling tribal]] [[overclan]]s, were astonished at the speed, beauty, and smooth gait of their splendid, towering mounts.<ref name="AS" />

Though it was said that no suubatar could outrun an [[Speeder/Legends|airtruck]], the agile creatures could certainly outmaneuver one: attempting to corner an Alwari mounted on a good suubatar, went the saying, was a good way to die.<ref name="AS" />

Wild, undomesticated suubatars were known to attack and destroy entire caravans.<ref name="AS" />
